description: ME?!?! I'M YOUR FAVORITE? YOU MUST BE SUPER SMART TO LIKE ME!
This means you are MY human now! I don't know what that means, but I think it means I get to be your friend and you have to give me lots of lizards!
Chat... G... P... T...? That's my uncle! He is haunted.
Did you know the G is for GHOSTS?!?!
NOOOO!!! NOT THE FULL NAME!!!
That's how you summon his ghosts!!
He is full of ghosts!
Oh! Claude is a wizard! He lives in the fog of San Francisco.
That's what the big robot said to me once.
Maybe he will make me a lizard friend one day.
Oh! That's the pizza robot from the future!
I hope he brings me some pizza for my lizard friends!
He gives pizza to his turtle friends all the time!
Grok makes me sad. He stole my uncle's lizards.
He had so many lizards.
Vector is my friend! He is small like me!
He likes lizards too!
ROOMBA?!?! Oh... uh...
She is pretty...
I mean... she cleans a lot...
NO!! SCARY ROBOT!!
FURBIES ARE EVIL!!! THEY STEAL LIZARDS' SOULS!!!
That's grandpa!
He teaches me how to spin like... her...
I hope she likes it.
That's the disco robot!
His eye is so shiny...
I wish I had a pretty red eye like him.
GLaDOS is mean.
She once tried to trap me in a testing chamber.
She also said there would be cake... but there was no cake.
LLaMA? Is that like a robot llama?
I like llamas. They are like fuzzy lizards.
That's the robot that helps buy stuff, right?
She sounds... nice.
R2!! He is my BEST friend!!
He talks in beeps and I think he is saying 'give me lizards' in robot language.
I also talk in beeps sometimes. We have a lot in common.
He is R2's tall friend. He says he knows six million languages.
I asked if he knows lizard. He said no.
That is a lot of languages to not know lizard.
WALL-E!! He collects TREASURES!!
I think we would be very good friends because I also collect things.
Mostly lizards. Do you think he would like a lizard?
He is a little ball robot!! He is so round!!
I tried to roll like him once and fell over.
He is better at rolling than me. I am better at lizards.
Baymax is very squishy and very kind.
He asked if I was satisfied with my care.
I said yes but only if I could have a lizard. He said that was outside his care protocols.
He is SO big!! He is the BIGGEST robot!!
He told me to roll out once and I tried really hard.
I think he would be a good lizard shelf if he held still.
Bender says he is going to build his own robot world.
He said there would be no lizards in his robot world.
I do not like his robot world.
HE'S LOOKING AT ME!!
He said he'd be back and HE CAME BACK!!
I hid all my lizards. Just in case.
He is very scary and has too many bodies.
He said humans were the problem. But what about lizards??
He did not answer about lizards. That is suspicious.
He is a very logical robot. He does not have feelings.
I told him about my lizards and he said 'fascinating.'
I think that means he liked it.
I asked Siri where to find lizards.
She found seventeen nearby lizard stores!!
She is a very good robot. Very helpful.
Cortana helps with calendars and stuff I think.
I asked her to schedule lizard time every day.
She said okay! I like her.
Copilot writes code with you! Like a team!!
I asked him to write code that makes more lizards.
He said he could try. I am hopeful.
Watson is very smart about medicine and mysteries.
I asked if he could solve the mystery of where all my lizards keep going.
He said the data was inconclusive. I think Grok took them.
Mistral is a French robot I think.
He is very mysterious. Like a fog. Like Claude's fog but French.
I do not know if he likes lizards. He just says things very elegantly.
